posts.text:
I hate the entire online political space so much right now, everything is so boring and rhetoric-oriented instead of actually arguing any fact or policy or even reality anymore.

It's just so tiresome. Imagine someone saying this about Hitler, "Hitler had some excesses", and pretending like it was meaningful criticism. These people are subversive, yes, but, more than anything else, they're shameless.
